title: Minimal CI pipeline: run the fast suite (incl. the GDD §13 analyzer test) on every push/PR
description: [RE-CREATED after working-tree cleaning deleted the untracked original] Gap surfaced by rev-c044 during the TASK-044 PCG32 review (LOW-2): GDD §13 asks for a CI/analyzer rule against System.Random/UnityEngine.Random in Barcade.Core, and TASK-044 delivers it as an executable fast-suite test — but the repo has NO CI pipeline at all (no .github/workflows), so nothing runs the suite on push. The cloud-batch workflow (PR #1) would also have benefited from an automated green/red signal. Add a minimal GitHub Actions workflow that restores and runs `dotnet test fast-tests/Barcade.Core.FastTests` on push to master and on pull_request, using an SDK version pinned to match the repo (8.0.x). Unity EditMode/PlayMode suites stay OUT of scope (no Unity license/runner in CI; those remain the local Editor gate). Keep it to one workflow file; no build matrix, no caching cleverness required.
acceptance_criteria: A GitHub Actions workflow runs the fast suite on push to master and on pull_request, failing the check on any test failure (which includes the §13 analyzer test)
The workflow pins an SDK channel compatible with the repo (8.0.x) and passes on the current master
README or the workflow file itself documents that Unity suites are intentionally excluded (local Editor gate)

comments.author: dev-t101
comments.body:
Hand-off. One commit on master: bec83b6 ci: add minimal GitHub Actions workflow. File: .github/workflows/fast-tests.yml. Workflow name "Fast Suite"; job id dotnet-test, job name "dotnet test (Barcade.Core.FastTests)". Triggers: push to master + pull_request (unfiltered). Runner ubuntu-latest. Steps: actions/checkout@v4 -> actions/setup-dotnet@v4 (dotnet-version '8.0.x') -> dotnet test fast-tests/Barcade.Core.FastTests --nologo.

AC1: push+PR triggers; dotnet test non-zero exit fails the check; §13 analyzer test rides in the same suite. AC2: 8.0.x pin matches local SDK 8.0.422; exact invocation sanity-checked locally = 554/554 green; confirmed dotnet test builds only Barcade.Core.FastTests.csproj (never the Unity-dependent Framework/Editor projects — no Unity install needed in CI); GitHub-side pass observation deferred to post-push UAT (dev cannot push). AC3: header comment block inside the workflow file documents the Unity-suite exclusion (README untouched, dev call per briefing).

UAT SCRIPT (post-push): on github.com/lordiwa/barcade, Actions tab or commit checks — expect check "Fast Suite / dotnet test (Barcade.Core.FastTests)" green; step "Run fast suite" log ends "Passed! - Failed: 0, Passed: 554, Skipped: 0, Total: 554". That observation closes AC2 and forms the uat-only verdict. YAML parse-validated before commit. Surface: .github/ only; rev-t045/rev-t053 surfaces untouched.
